title: docs(north-star): write docs/NORTH-STAR.md in English as the governing original
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiHXKqxUqDPJKZyNHP7BoqTb)_
Fixes #28816
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么:`docs/NORTH-STAR.md` 从中文改写为英文正本,125 行逐行对译,梯子 80 行一行不增不减不换序不改档,`轴 · 功能点 · 清单区 · 项 id` 形状与 id、路步编号原样;原「English summary」节退役;仓内 12 个按旧中文节题引用北极星的读者改为新英文节题。
- 为什么改:维护者原话「创建一个任务,北极星应该用英文写」。北极星压过 `AGENTS.md`,此前只有不具约束力的英文摘要,英文读者与 Agent 读不到约束全文;仓内其余产物皆英文。
- 风险与回滚:只改文档与注释,不改任何包的发布内容(`skip-changeset`)。风险在译文走样;回滚即 revert 本 PR 的单个提交。
- 先看:① `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`(整文件,重点看「Priority」四条与「Instruments serve the fleet」段);② `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md` L22–L23(为守 120 字节行宽就地重切的两行);③ `AGENTS.md` L206。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n -e 路上的功能点 -e 仪器为车队服务 -e 现在不做 -e 做出来的是什么` 应零命中;`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 应绿。
- 需要你做的:Tier H 受管面(`docs/NORTH-STAR.md`、`AGENTS.md`、`.claude/**`),需要你的一次 APPROVED review;译文措辞有异议请直接在 PR 上批注。

## What changes

`docs/NORTH-STAR.md` is rewritten in English as the governing original. The Chinese body (lines 1–125 on `main`) is translated line for line: 125 lines in, 125 lines out; 80 ladder rows in, 80 out, each keeping its `axis · feature · checklist area · item ids` shape with the axis, the checklist area and every item id byte-identical to `main` (checked mechanically, row by row). The road step numbers ① to ⑥ are unchanged. The non-governing `## English summary` (lines 127–179) is retired: the English text is now the original, so a second copy would only drift.

Every reader that cited a North Star section by its old Chinese title is renamed to the new English title: `AGENTS.md` L206, the pm-dispatch skill (`SKILL.md` L120, `references/filing-gate.md` L25/L37/L49, `references/triage-duties.md` L58/L59, `references/execution-duties.md` L49, `references/lanes/skills.md` L22/L23, `references/lanes/spec.md` L23), the `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` comment (L571, L595), plus three readers outside the card's *Measured* list that the card's own test (zero hits outside revision history) reaches: `CONTRIBUTING.md` L116 (said an English summary closes the file), `docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md` L305 (quotes the definition line), and two code comments (`packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.runtime-surface.test.ts` L48/L315, `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/plugin-component-input-deprecation.test.ts` L24). Generic uses of 优先级 / 账本 that do not point at the North Star are untouched. Revision history in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` and the release-owned `ui/packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` entries keep their old spellings, as the card asks.

Quoted maintainer rulings: the North Star quotes none, so nothing stayed in Chinese and no gloss was added. The one marker, 「清单项待写」, becomes `(checklist item to be written)`; on `main` today exactly one ladder row carries it (`standalone-boot-no-cloud`), not three as the card measured at `70bf434385` — two rows have had their items written since.

### Title mapping (old → new)

| Old (Chinese) | New (English) |
|:---|:---|
| ObjectStack 北极星 | ObjectStack North Star |
| 我们是什么 | What we are |
| 给谁 | Who it is for |
| 做出来的是什么 | What gets built |
| 什么算做好 | What counts as done |
| 唯一的度量,那条路 | The one measure: the road |
| 路上的功能点 | Features on the road |
| ① 出发:`npm create objectstack` 起项目,写元数据 | ① Set out: start a project with `npm create objectstack`, write metadata |
| ② 本地跑起来、看到 —— … | ② Run it locally and see it — … |
| ③ 验证:响亮拒绝错的,放行对的 | ③ Verify: loudly reject what is wrong, let through what is right |
| ④ 发布并装进一个环境 | ④ Publish and install into an environment |
| ⑤ 接一个 Agent(社区版走 MCP),让它完成一次真实业务操作 | ⑤ Connect an agent (MCP in the community edition) and have it complete one real business operation |
| ⑥ 按客户一句话需求迭代一次 | ⑥ Iterate once on a one-sentence customer request |
| 优先级 | Priority |
| 阶段姿态 | Stage posture |
| 仪器为车队服务 | Instruments serve the fleet |
| 现在不做 | Not now |
| 账本 | The ledger |
| 「清单项待写」 (marker) | (checklist item to be written) |
| ## English summary | retired |

Terms of art rendered consistently with the rest of the repo: 仪器 → instrument (`仪器卡` → instrument card), 工具卡 → tooling card, 车队 → fleet, 席位 → seat, 清单 → checklist, 账本 → ledger, 路 → road, 处方 → prescription, 响亮 → loud, 兑现 → honoured.

### Line budget (ratcheted files)

|:---|:---|:---|
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | 319 → 319 | L120 table row 336 → 338 bytes (pin 341) |
| `references/filing-gate.md` | 66 → 66 | L49 113 → 119 bytes |
| `references/triage-duties.md` | 102 → 102 | |
| `references/execution-duties.md` | 188 → 188 | L49 only; PR #28773's edited lines (L42, L45–47, L55, L62) untouched |
| `references/lanes/skills.md` | 32 → 32 | L22 119 → 115 B and L23 115 → 115 B, re-cut in place (`本车道 ` and `席位` dropped, the lane file already scopes both) |

| `AGENTS.md` | 1050 → 1050 | L206 94 bytes |

## Tests

No runtime behaviour changes. The two test files touched change a comment only; each was run as a file after building its closure.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-security-posture.runtime-surface.test.ts` (under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`): `Test Files 1 passed (1)` · `Tests 21 passed (21)` · `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types exec vitest run --root ../.. --maxWorkers=2 packages/types/src/__tests__/plugin-component-input-deprecation.test.ts` (under the lock): `Test Files 1 passed (1)` · `Tests 7 passed (7)` · `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Ladder fidelity, mechanical: `main`'s body and this file compared row by row — 125 lines in / 125 out, 80 rows in / 80 out, axis + checklist area + item ids identical on every row, blank / bold / numbered line structure identical, 0 CJK characters remaining (scratch script, not committed).
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changes (prose and comments only).

## Acceptance notes

- The road paragraph says "four promises" and then lists five (①, ②③, ④, ⑤, ⑥). Translated as written; changing the count would be a content edit the card excludes.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/translations/zh-CN.objects.generated.ts` still matches `给谁` — a generic phrase in a help string, not a North Star reference; untouched.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/diagnostics/CloudAiModelStatus.test.tsx` L82 says "the English summary" about a diagnostics payload, not this file; untouched.

## Verification

Gate union derived on the final head `18aaea2806` by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 85 commands. Every one ran locally with its exit code captured before any pipe (`cmd > LOG 2>&1; EXIT=$?`); all 85 exit 0 on the final tree. Reconciliation `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: `85 derived, 85 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, exit 0.

The four gates the card names, each exit 0 at head `18aaea2806`: `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` (no ceiling moved; the one declared cross-file-move set is untouched), `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` (106 files clean), `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` (one coherent copy, 109 files scanned), `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose` (13 registered surfaces named).

<details><summary>Five commands first refused on an unbuilt prerequisite, then passed after the build — none a finding</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` (exit 3, `@objectstack/lint` not built), `pnpm check:docs-transcript-drift` (exit 3, same), `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, several packages without `dist/`), `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure` (exit 3, `packages/objectql/dist` absent), `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (exit 1: `unit-registry-absence-collision.test.ts` could not resolve `@objectstack/client`, unbuilt; 168/169 files passed). After `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2` under the lock (118/118 tasks, 9m22s, `VERDICT command-exit 0`) each re-ran with its exact derived spelling: all five exit 0; the ui run then reads `Test Files 169 passed | 2 skipped (171)` · `Tests 4900 passed | 2 skipped (4902)`. The working tree stayed clean through every build (`git status --porcelain` empty).

</details>

Old-title grep, repo-wide (`git grep`, files / hits), before → after at `3cb8553c94` → `18aaea2806`: 路上的功能点 3/5 → 0/0 · 仪器为车队服务 4/6 → 0/0 · 现在不做 2/3 → 0/0 · 唯一的度量 1/2 → 0/0 · 什么算做好 1/2 → 0/0 · 做出来的是什么 5/6 → 0/0 · 我们是什么 1/2 → 0/0 · 阶段姿态 3/4 → 1/1 (release-owned `ui/packages/types/CHANGELOG.md`) · 清单项待写 2/4 → 1/1 (revision history in `areas/studio-authoring.json`, kept as the card asks) · 给谁 2/3 → 1/1 (a generic help string, not a reference) · `English summary` 5/5 → 3/3 (two release-owned CHANGELOG entries and one unrelated test comment) · 「优先级」 / 〈优先级〉 as a North Star citation 5 → 0 · 账本」 0 → 0.

CI families beyond this union (the full `Lint & Repo Gates` sweep, `Test Core`, the UI jobs) are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run locally. Not run locally and declared: `test:repo` (CI-owned), `check:dev-prereqs` / `check:skill-frame-freshness` (local-only readings; the four-axis frame text did not move).
